newsitem.title: USA: U.S. columnist Mike Royko dies.
newsitem.headline: U.S. columnist Mike Royko dies.

text.p: Noted U.S. journalist and Pulitzer Prize-winning columnist Mike Royko died on Tuesday, one week after suffering a brain aneurysm, his family said. He was 64.

The Chicago Tribune writer, whose syndicated column was a regular feature in newspapers big and small across the United States, suffered a seizure at his home last Tuesday and later underwent surgery the following day at Northwestern Memorial Hospital.

Royko was the author of "Boss," a book about the late Chicago Mayor Richard J. Daley, father of current Mayor Richard M. Daley. His satirical commentary has routinely skewered venal politicians, crooked policemen and inflated egos.
Royko joined the Tribune in 1984, jumping from the rival Chicago Sun-Times. He had previously worked for the now defunct Chicago Daily News, beginning there in 1959.
